description: Test suite for the ChatLog component, verifying behavior such as message pruning, rendering, managing assistant and tool components, handling BTW messages, and managing pending user messages.

classes.name: ChatLog
classes.description: Represents a chat log component managing messages, assistant and tool states, BTW messages, and pending user messages.

methods.name: addSystem
methods.description: Adds a system message to the chat log.

methods.name: startAssistant
methods.description: Starts an assistant component with a given name and run ID.

methods.name: updateAssistant
methods.description: Updates an existing assistant component identified by run ID.

methods.name: addUser
methods.description: Adds a user message to the chat log.

methods.name: startTool
methods.description: Starts a tool component with specified name, type, and options.

methods.name: updateToolResult
methods.description: Updates a tool component with the provided result data.

methods.name: showBtw
methods.description: Displays a BTW (by the way) message with a question and text.

methods.name: dismissBtw
methods.description: Hides the currently visible BTW message.

methods.name: hasVisibleBtw
methods.description: Checks if a BTW message is currently visible.

methods.name: clearAll
methods.description: Clears all messages, optionally preserving pending users.

methods.name: countPendingUsers
methods.description: Returns the number of pending user messages.

methods.name: commitPendingUser
methods.description: Marks a pending user message as committed, removing it from pending.

methods.name: reconcilePendingUsers
methods.description: Reconciles pending user messages with a list of received messages, based on timestamps.
